_about: Breakable lamps: one bullet breaks the fixture, removes its linked lights and cones (a lit alarm lamp's red ambient glow and a kerosene lamp's flame too; the room probe a tube lamp lights keeps only its share without the lamp, probe_light.py), and displays the broken model. Source authored by scripts/breakable-lamps/make_edits.py from manifest-base projects and Research. Explicit indices refer to the final render_visuals after these additions. Bulb bounds use stock geometry and placed rotation/scale. Legacy cones start at the emitter: their full-opacity material exposes offsets hidden by the 0.26 material. Stock and v0.21 placements stay unchanged.
